subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

He got medals __time after time __by following the instructions of his mentor.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **'time after time'** means again and again; repeatedly.(बार - बार)

 
 
• **Example **- **Time after time** she gets involved in relationships with the wrong men.
 
 
 
• '**Repeatedly**' means over and over again, or many times.(दोहराते हुए)
 
 
• **Example **- Ecologists have **repeatedly **warned us about the effects of global warming.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the same meaning of ** 'time after time'** is **'Repeatedly'**.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is '**Repeatedly**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meaning and example sentences:

 
• **Twice **(दो बार) - Means two times.

 
 
• **Example **- She takes the dog for a walk **twice **daily.
 
 
 
• **Once **(एक बार) - Means one time only; on one occasion.
 
 
• **Example **- My boss is a nice man **once **you get to know him
 
 
 
• **Rarely **(कभी-कभार) - Means something that happens seldom.
 
 
• **Example **- He is **rarely **seen in public.
